_about: Where every Praxis setting came from. Generated by scripts/build_praxis.py; edit the spec there.

Praxis | P01 - Require MFA for all users.why: Replaces C001. Same intent, but phones are included: the library's answer for phones is app protection (P11), not an exemption from MFA.

citations.course: Packt Unified SecOps Playbook with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR and Security Copilot 2025
Pluralsight AB-900 Identify the Core Features and Objects of Microsoft 365 Services 2026
Pluralsight Device Enrollment Strategies in Microsoft Intune 2026

settings.note: C001 excluded Android and iOS. The library protects phones with app protection policies instead, see P11.

Praxis | P02 - Require phishing-resistan.why: Replaces C003a and C003b. C003b was named phishing-resistant but granted ordinary MFA, which accepts SMS.

settings.value: Phishing-resistant MFA (built-in 0004: Windows Hello, FIDO2, certificate)

citations.course: O'Reilly Learning Ransomware Response and Recovery 2026
O'Reilly Zero Trust Networks 2nd Edition 2024
Pluralsight AB-900 Identify the Core Features and Objects of Microsoft 365 Services 2026
Packt Unified SecOps Playbook with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR and Security Copilot 2025

settings.note: The library says administrators; which roles count as administrator is Microsoft's list from its own phishing-resistant template. C003a covered 11 of Microsoft's 14 MFA roles.

Praxis | P11 - Phones must use app prote.why: Closes the phone gap C001 left open, the way the library recommends: protect company data in the app rather than exempt the phone.

settings.value: app protection policy or compliant device

citations.course: Pluralsight Device Enrollment Strategies in Microsoft Intune 2026

settings.note: Needs Intune app protection policies for iOS and Android assigned to the same users before this is enforced; otherwise phones are simply blocked.

citations.course: Pluralsight SharePoint Fundamentals and Architecture 2026

settings.note: The library has nothing on device code flow. Microsoft ships this as its own managed policy, and CIS 5.2.2.12 requires it.

settings.setting: Access from outside the client's countries
settings.value: block, with a travel exclusion group

citations.course: Azure Security Cookbook

citations.course: Packt AB-900 Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration 2026

settings.note: Revokes sessions as soon as a user is disabled or leaves an allowed location. Clients whose traffic leaves through different IP addresses (split tunnel VPN) need testing in report-only first.
